responsibility: Provides the autogenerated documentation URL mapping for the main Nios II target options declared in nios2.opt. It records the GCC manual anchor suffixes for architecture, endianness, hardware multiply/divide, cache behavior, GP-relative addressing, custom FPU configuration, and related Nios II switches, serving as a companion to the generated option machinery so help and diagnostic paths can link target options to the proper manual entries rather than implementing backend behavior directly.
